Production inspect 2026-10-19 (main bf6b7555e): share_library_docs_to_mortgage_request() holds EXECUTE for PUBLIC, checksops and the owner; SQL 29 revokes PUBLIC only, so its guard refuses (function_acl_replaceable) until SQL 103 has left the owner as the only grantee. SQL 29's file and its intended fingerprint 1271ea9b61ec983f88e911b23c569403979fb5f560880021b58d3b1e57243c79 are unchanged. No predecessor: SQL 103 does not need SQL 29, is a no-op once the owner is the only grantee (staging after SQL 29: the tools refuse it as already in place) and is safe before or after SQL 90. Nothing in the repository grants the function to checksops or authenticated again, so it is not re-run after SQL 29.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 103: sql103-share-library-trigger-acl-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql103-share-library-trigger-acl); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql103 (runs_before sql29). intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the function's EXECUTE ACL with grantors (spec acl_functions, render.grantors), owner only. The post-conditions also require the function's body, attributes and owner unchanged. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
